item.title: OCR using LLM: evaluating capabilities
item.description:
Introduction

l Taxhacker, is interesting open source project that uses LLM for OCR to extract text and other useful information from images (e.g. invoices) and builds Tracker (using extracted information) for income/expenses or whatever else that needs to be tracked and involves performing scanning to extract data. It uses LiteLLM Proxy so that any AI Provider can be plugged in.

I decided to try OCR capabilities of LLM locally with below setup,
